rationale: Roberts is likely to keep the opinion narrow and institutional, but Kagan is also a strong candidate to write a grammar-and-structure opinion emphasizing the prefatory negative’s distributive effect and rejecting lenity as unnecessary. A Gorsuch-led dissent is the most probable separate writing, potentially drawing Sotomayor and/or Jackson, with a smaller chance of an Alito or Thomas concurrence to underscore anti-lenity or textualist points.
